sources.title: The fastest way to run Qwen 3.8 on a Mac. - GitHub
sources.snippet: The fastest way to run Qwen 3.8 on a Mac. MTPLX is a native Mac app and a command line that runs local language models on Apple Silicon with the model's own multi-token prediction (MTP) heads. It runs Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, the 125B mixture of experts, Qwen 3.8 27B and Prism ML's Ternary Bonsai 2 27B, plus Qwen 3.6, Qwen 3.5 and Gemma 4.
